title: Why Something Rather Than Nothing

canonical_node.axiom: Something exists rather than nothing, and this is undeniable.
definitions: Existence: that which is not nothing; the state of being real.
Nothing: the absence of any existence; ontological nullity.
Distinguishability: the property of being different from something else, especially from nothing.
Information: the capacity to distinguish states; equivalently, distinguishability.
derivation: If something exists, it must be distinguishable from nothing; otherwise it would be nothing.
P0.2: x,y : x  y (Existence requires distinguishability).
P0.3: H(X) = - p(x) log p(x); Information  Distinguishability.
P0.4: Whatever exists is intelligible (declared, not derived).
canonical_node.action: Treat P0.1 as the irreducible foundation. Reject any claim that denies existence or presupposes non-existence as a stable state. Use P0.1 to block nihilism, radical skepticism, and solipsism in discourse.
boundary: Does not derive existence from anything prior; existence is primitive.
Does not claim to explain why something exists; only that it does.
Does not assert the nature of what exists beyond distinguishability and intelligibility.
Does not claim that all existence is physical or material.
test: Attempt to deny P0.1 without presupposing existence; if the denial requires a speaker/thinker/writer, the denial is self-refuting.
Check that any proposed 'nothing' is not actually something (e.g., quantum vacuum, imagined nothing).
Verify that any physical theory presupposes existence (e.g., wavefunctions, spacetime, fields).

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides an undeniable foundation for all subsequent axioms; blocks radical skepticism and nihilism at the root.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Establishes the minimal ontological commitment: something exists.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without P0.1, no other axiom can be asserted; the entire framework collapses into incoherence.
dg5_translation_registers: Physical: presupposed by all physical theories

overstatement_risks: Claims 'undeniable' but proof is dialectical, not formal.
Equates distinguishability with information without rigorous definition.
Uses scripture as support, which is not a logical proof.
May overstate the self-refutation of solipsism (it concedes existence but not the rest).
kill_conditions: A coherent model of non-existence that does not presuppose existence.
A meaningful predication of 'nothing' without existential presupposition.
A formal counterexample to the self-refutation argument.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the self-refutation argument in a proof assistant (e.g., Lean) to establish LEAN_FORMAL_PROOF.

plain_summary: This document establishes the foundational axiom that something exists, arguing that any denial is self-refuting. It defines existence, nothing, distinguishability, and information, and derives that existence requires distinguishability which is information. The document is coherent as an axiom but lacks formal proof; it is admissible as a foundational axiom but should not be treated as proven beyond dialectical argument.
